content: @gorhom/bottom-sheet v5.2.14 ships first-class support for react-native-reanimated v4 and New Architecture (peer dep: reanimated >=3.16.0 || >=4.0.0-, gesture-handler >=2.16.1) -- matches Apsis's pinned reanimated 4.5.0. Earlier v4-era bottom-sheet versions were broken under Reanimated 4; must use v5.x. Expo SDK also ships an experimental native BottomSheet drop-in (@expo/ui) as of SDK 57 docs but availability in SDK 56 is unconfirmed and it lacks inline-peek and full customization -- gorhom is the safer choice for the search-first exercise picker.
